high_level_description: This image shows a collection of seashells arranged on a denim fabric background. The shells vary in size, shape, and color, featuring a range of natural patterns and textures. Some shells have smooth, rounded edges, while others are more angular or have ridges. The colors include shades of white, beige, brown, red, and gray, with some shells displaying intricate patterns such as stripes and spots. The denim fabric beneath the shells has a textured appearance, typical of jeans, with visible stitching and a slightly worn look.
